title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at coordinates [0.0196, 0.0196] with a radius of 0.0196. For the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a slightly smaller radius of 0.0188. Apply a scale factor of 0.0393 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector to position it correctly. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion forms a new solid body. The final dimensions of the part are 0.0393 units in length, 0.0393 units in width, and 0.75 units in height. The final shape consists of a cylindrical base with a smaller cylindrical protrusion at the top.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0196, 0.0196)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0196)  # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0188)  # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical object
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = cylinder
